Ellen (PM): Quick sync  we need a tight rollout plan for Tuesday's model switch. Goals: avoid traffic oscillation, let customers opt-out, and have clear auto-degrade + manual quality checks.

Ravi (Eng): Proposed per-region slices: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Stability windows: 20m at small slices, 30m at 60%. Auto-gates: p95 latency +25% vs baseline, error_rate_p95 > 0.8%, qps drop > 12%. On gate -> reduce slice 50% and pause 10m.

Sam (SRE): Add resource gate: GPU_util >90% for >4m -> demote region to soft-degrade. Also health check: GET /canary/health?region=eu-west returns 200. Two non-200s -> pause ramp + page on-call.

Lina (CS): Customer asks: opt-out API + webhook on bump. For tenants >50qps require 12h notice via email + portal banner. We should also allow scheduled opt-in windows for sensitive accounts.

Ravi (Eng): Flags example:
```
rollout_enabled: true
steps: [1,5,20,60,100]
stability_minutes: {1:20,5:20,20:20,60:30}
per_tenant_cap_qps: 250
auto_fallback: model-v1-quant
soft_degrade_order: [disable_reranking, cap_tokens:512, fallback]
opt_out_endpoint: /v1/tenants/{id}/rollout
```

Sam (SRE): Runbook: on first gate trip -> halve slice, remove top 5 tenants from slice for 10m, re-evaluate. If still failing -> apply soft-degrade. If still failing -> rollback region to previous model. Global capacity issue -> fallback to quantized variant.

release-bot: Canary controller: starting slice=us-east1 pct=1 started_by=Ellen ts=1755558000 :rocket:

Ellen (PM): Decision recap: use [1,5,20,60,100] ramp, stability windows as above, auto gates on latency/errors/qps/util, soft-degrade before rollback, opt-out API + webhook + 12h notice for large tenants, and quality alerts (manual review) sent to #product and #support. I'll create the launch checklist and assign owners.
